code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, and relative monocytosis and basophilia. Erythrocytosis is present, possibly as a compensatory response to hypoxemia. Mild metabolic acidosis is suggested by low total CO₂. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., respiratory or hematologic disorders) are recommended.
